description_en: Queries the availability status of node IP addresses to determine the availability of the node acceleration service
description_zh: 调用DescribeIpStatus查询节点IP可用状态，进而根据节点IP可用状态来了解节点加速服务的可用状态
name: DescribeIpStatus

parameters.help_en: The list of IP addresses to query. You can query up to 20 IP addresses at a time. Separate multiple IP addresses with underscores (_). Example: ip1_ip2_ip3
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的IP地址列表，最多支持批量查询20个IP地址，IP地址之间使用下划线_分隔，如：ip1_ip2_ip3
parameters.name: ips

IpStatus.description_en: The list of node IP address statuses

status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:

nonali: Not a Content Delivery Network (CDN) point of presence.
normal: A Content Delivery Network (CDN) point of presence in the normal state.
abnormal: A Content Delivery Network (CDN) point of presence in the abnormal state
status.description_zh:
状态。
